pages.title: Hulitherium
pages.text: $(o)Hulitherium$() ($(o)Hulitherium tomasettii$()) was a diprotodont from the highland forests of New Guinea, known from the Late Pleistocene.$(br2)It is sometimes compared to a giant panda in build, and may have fed on bamboo and other forest plants.$(br2)Like other New Guinea diprotodonts, it was much smaller than its relatives on the Australian mainland.
